Job Purpose :
To manage and optimize the performance of sales promotors across channels by ensuring effective deployment, capability development, performance tracking, and productivity monitoring to drive sales growth, product visibility, and customer advocacy

Main Responsibilities :
1. Determining the optimal headcount of promotors for each region and retail outlet based on foot traffic and sales potential.
2. Monitoring daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets for the promotor force, identifying underperformers for coaching or reallocation.
3. Ensure promotors are equipped with selling skills, customer engagement techniques, and brand knowledge.
4. Ensure promotors execute advocacy process, sales campaigns, new product offering, and merchandising standards
5. Maintaining the relationship with third-party manpower agencies to ensure quality recruitments

Employment Status:

Contract (C)

• Minimum lulusan D3 politeknik
• Pengalaman bekeja di industri pharmasi atau food and beverage minimal 1-4 tahun
• Memiliki daya analisis yang baik
• Memahami wiring diagram dan instalasi listrik 1 dan 3 phase
• Melakukan koordinasi dan perencanaan dalam perawatan dan perbaikan mesin produksi phamasi, panel listrik, kabel jaringan, penerangan serta fasilitas utility electric (genset, boiler, air compressor, hydrant) lainnya yang berada di pabrik secara berkala
• Melakukan perencanaan dan pelaksanaan dalam proses perawatan panel listrik distribusi dan panel kontrol mesin dan utama secara berkala
• Melakukan perencanaan dan pelaksanaan dalam mencegah terjadinya perbaikan/perakitan mesin/panel distribusi/panel kontrol dengan mempersiapkan kebutuhan aksesoris/part panel sesuai dengan kebutuhannya
• Melakukan perencanaan dalam perbaikan yang bersifat internal maupun eksternal
• Melakukan improvement setiap waktu untuk meningkatkan skill individu
• Mempu dan memahami penggunaan alat ukur teknis.
• Memahami prinsip kerja pneumatik & hidrolik. serta part-part penunjang.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-klbf-JR26_001875.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Supervise engineering staff and ensure effective execution of engineering plans.
- Resolve escalated technical issues.
- Prepare performance reports and documentation.
- Ensure compliance with engineering standards and regulations.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives.
- Coordinate with other departments to ensure project alignment.
- Monitor and evaluate the performance of engineering staff.
- Provide training and development opportunities for team members.

- Mengawasi staf teknik dan memastikan pelaksanaan rencana teknik yang efektif.
- Menyelesaikan masalah teknis yang meningkat.
- Menyiapkan laporan kinerja dan dokumentasi.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar dan regulasi teknik.
- Mendukung inisiatif perbaikan berkelanjutan.
- Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain untuk memastikan keselarasan proyek.
- Memantau dan mengevaluasi kinerja staf teknik.
- Memberikan pelatihan dan peluang pengembangan untuk anggota tim.

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
